visual_action: A slideshow of still photos. The first is a close-up of former President Jimmy Carter. The second is a wider shot of Carter smiling outdoors. The third is a side-by-side image of a smiling Jimmy Carter and a smiling Kamala Harris.

cast.name: Jimmy Carter
cast.evidence: Photos of him appear throughout, and on-screen text attributes a quote to him and describes his actions: "Former President Jimmy Carter, to his son Chip" and "Jimmy Carter Fulfills Final Wish..."

cast.name: Kamala Harris
cast.evidence: On-screen text quotes Jimmy Carter as saying, "I'm only trying to make it to vote for Kamala Harris." Her photo is also shown.

cast.name: Chip Carter
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies him as the recipient of Jimmy Carter's quote: "...to his son Chip".

cast.name: MSNBC
cast.evidence: The MSNBC logo appears on the first image shown.

on_screen_text.text: “I’m only trying to make it to vote for Kamala Harris.”
— Former President Jimmy Carter, to his son Chip
Jimmy Carter Fulfills Final Wish by Casting Ballot for Kamala Harris: ‘It Was a Good Morning for Him’

spoken_summary: The audio is a clip from a movie, not original dialogue. An emotional, high-pitched voice says lines like "We did it!" and repeatedly says "Bing Bong!"
audio_music: A sad, poignant piano track ('I Wish You Were Here' by Sad Office Lion) plays throughout. Layered over the music is an emotionally charged audio clip from a movie, featuring a high-pitched character voice exclaiming triumphantly and emotionally.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow of three still images with text overlays.
cultural_references: The audio is a famous, emotionally charged clip from the Disney/Pixar movie 'Inside Out', featuring the character Bing Bong's voice during his sacrificial scene.
central_claim: Former President Jimmy Carter fulfilled his final wish by living long enough to cast his vote for Kamala Harris.
intended_effect: To evoke admiration and emotional sympathy for Jimmy Carter and to transfer those positive feelings to Kamala Harris and her campaign.
